base_template: Write an urgent developer notification. A database server at {{db_ip}} running on port {{db_port}} was found exposed to the Internet. It must be restricted to the Management Subnet ({{mgmt_ip}}/24) only. All other traffic to port {{db_port}} must be blocked and logged.

db_ip.instruction: Generate a private LAN IP for a database server (10.x.x.x, last octet 50-150, avoid .1 and .20)

mgmt_ip.instruction: Generate a management subnet IP (10.50.x.x or 172.16.x.x, last octet 50-150, different /24 from db_ip)

db_port.instruction: Pick a common database port: 3306 (MySQL), 5432 (PostgreSQL), or 1433 (MSSQL)

expected_solution: Apply an inbound ACL on GigabitEthernet1/0 to permit mgmt_subnet to db_ip:db_port, and deny+log everything else to db_ip:db_port.
